evidence.why: Post-increment threshold and one-time tally guard.

facts.rationale: Corrects an exact-frame implication while preserving the supported panel lifecycle.
facts.value: All six detail-text slots begin null. A qualifying selection replaces the six-object panel, and occupied slots remain available to its renderer until replaced or removed. During unpaused playback, after incrementing the timeline, the first update with timeline >= 0x1285 and no tally object removes and clears all six slots before creating the final hit tally. Accelerated playback can cross this threshold without landing exactly on 0x1285.

evidence.why: Single cue check outside pause guard.

facts.rationale: Clarifies the actual cue scheduler rather than implying a sorted schedule or explicit termination branch.
facts.value: Authored metadata controls unconditional or predicate-gated credit eligibility, alternate localized pages, role suppression and exceptional entry-index behavior. Language-indexed widths define projected selection corners. Sound cues are consumed in authored array order, at most one per main-process invocation when the timeline reaches or exceeds the current cue's frame; this check is outside the pause guard. The frame sequence is not monotonic: 2350 is followed by 2000. The final 0x7FFFFFFF frame acts as an unreachable normal-play sentinel, not an explicitly tested terminator.

evidence.why: Timeline, speed, tally and pause transitions.

facts.rationale: Replaces the simple B-toggle description with the actual numeric-state branches and threshold semantics.
facts.value: Runtime state initializes with timeline 0, pause state 0, playback step 1, cooldown 0, visual offsets 0, speed-mode flag 0 and cue index 0. Timeline advancement occurs only in pause state 0. Start toggles steps 1 and 6 before the tally threshold and forces step 1 afterward. B in state 0 enters state 1 before the threshold even without a selected credit. In state 1, a recognized trigger resumes only if it is not B or no credit is selected, then sets cooldown to 0x3C. The first unpaused post-increment timeline >= 0x1285 with no tally creates the tally and resets the playback step to 1.

evidence.why: Stick mapping, geometry and trigger priority.
Detail, hit, tally and control outputs.

facts.rationale: Adds useful missing trigger priority and direct-position semantics while retaining the established input/output flow.
facts.value: Reads controller sticks and A/B/Start/Z triggers, camera FOV, sorted credit transforms, per-entry hit state, language and unlock predicates, authored text metadata, timeline controls and sound cues. Dead-zoned stick values are nonlinearly mapped directly to cursor coordinates, not integrated as velocity; Y is clamped to +/-2.6 before projection scaling. Trigger selection has A > B > Start > Z priority. These inputs drive projected quadrilateral selection, localized detail replacement, hit colors and particles, playback controls and a final reduction counting entries with hit state >= 1 across all 198 records.

evidence.why: Hit, timeline, tally, speed, pause and cue ordering.

facts.rationale: Preserves ordering, exceptional pause behavior and the distinction between crossed thresholds and an equality event.
facts.value: Selection is attempted only while timeline < 0x1285. B can replace selected-credit details even while paused; A can do so only in pause state 0, and hit registration additionally requires cooldown 0. Hits increment per-entry state, but the tally counts each entry only once. In pause state 0, the timeline advances by the current step; the first post-increment timeline >= 0x1285 with no tally removes six detail objects, creates the tally and sets step 1. Audio fading is requested on every unpaused update at >= 0x12D5, while the closing flash and key-off occur at == 0x1311. Start then toggles pre-tally steps 1/6. Extra particle updates and cooldown decrement occur outside the pause guard. B in state 0 enters state 1 before the tally threshold regardless of selection; state 1 resumes on recognized input unless that input is B over a selected credit, and resume sets cooldown 0x3C. Finally, at most one due sound cue is played and its index advanced, including while paused.

evidence.why: Thresholds, detail lifetime and pause transitions.

facts.rationale: Corrects exact-frame and text-lifetime ambiguities and separates pause behavior from the existence of a selection.
facts.value: The Staff Roll uses numeric pause states 0 and 1 and playback steps 1 or 6. Animation callbacks stop advancing when the shared pause flag is nonzero, but entry-text maintenance and sorting continue. Start toggles speed before the tally threshold. B in state 0 enters state 1 before that threshold even without a selected credit; qualifying later input resumes the looked-up GObj's processes and sets a 60-update cooldown. The first unpaused post-increment timeline >= 0x1285 with no tally replaces the six detail texts, not all scrolling credit text, with a unique-hit tally and restores step 1. Audio fading is requested at >= 0x12D5; the closing flash occurs at == 0x1311; the frame callback requests scene exit at >= 0x134D. The exit callback itself performs no teardown.
